text: Pump selection shall provide a NPSH available margin over NPSH required (NPSH3) of at least 1.0 m or 1.3 x NPSH3 at rated flow, whichever is greater, and 1.5 m or 1.5 x NPSH3 for boiler feed and condensate pumps at minimum hotwell / deaerator level. NPSH available shall be calculated on the lowest liquid level and the highest liquid temperature of the operating cases.
